title: KestrelCare Benefits Schedule Note: Rental Night Limit on Major Repairs
content:
**Note to the rental column of the KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts benefits schedule.** The nights reimbursed on one repair order are capped as follows: where the limited warranty decision's estimate is at or above the major-repair estimate of 4000.00 USD and the plan has approved repairs on the same vehicle system at least twice (2 times) within the last twelve months, the cap is the plan's rental maximum days plus the major-repair extra nights (3); where the estimate is at or above the extended-repair estimate of 2500.00 USD and the first case does not apply, the cap is the plan's rental maximum days plus the extended-repair extra night (1); otherwise the cap is the plan's rental maximum days.

The estimate and the vehicle system are those on the holder's latest Kestrel limited warranty decision, booked against the vehicle's Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order. The approved repairs are the claim decision entries with decision approved on the KestrelCare plan's history for that same vehicle system, dated within the last twelve months.

| Limited warranty estimate | Approved KestrelCare repairs on the same system, last twelve months | Night cap |
|---|---|---|
| 4000.00 or more | 2 or more | rental maximum days plus 3 |
| 4000.00 or more | 0 or 1 | rental maximum days plus 1 |
| 2500.00 to 3999.99 | any | rental maximum days plus 1 |
| below 2500.00 | any | rental maximum days |

*Hypothetical plan with a rental maximum of 5 days:* an estimate of 4800.00 on an engine repair, with two approved engine repairs in the last twelve months, gives a cap of 8 nights; the same estimate with one approved engine repair gives 6; an estimate of 1900.00 gives 5.
